definitions: To do something without a plan or prior experience, relying on instinct and improvisation.
To operate in a spontaneous and unorganized way.
examples: We were flying by the seat of our pants during the whole project.
She's been flying by the seat of her pants since the new manager left.
I had no idea what I was doing, just flying by the seat of my pants.
lemma: fly by the seat of one's pants
source: flying by the seat of my pants
